title: The pullback of a module of finite type is of finite type
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the pullback of a module of finite type is again of finite type (author lemma at source lines 1036-1042, label lemma-pullback-finite-type). The proof (source lines 1044-1069) reduces to a module generated by finitely many global sections using the argument of the corresponding statement for modules generated by sections, and then transports the finite presentation along the pullback by its compatibility with colimits and right exactness (proof lines 1045-1066). The reduction and the transport of the finite surjection are the content. H2.
